Copies a single file from the templates folder to the destination.

## Signature

```typescript
copyFile(input: {
        sourceFileRelativePath: string;
        destinationFilePath?: string;
    }): Promise<void>;
```

## Returns

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when the file has been copied.

## Remarks

This method resolves the source file path relative to the templates folder and copies it to the destination, creating any necessary parent directories. The file is copied without modifications, preserving its content and structure. Use [InitTemplateBase.render()](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/inittemplatebase/render) instead if variable substitution is needed.
